      "title": "Class: other (wrong person-facing remedy). Where: metasystem/internal/steward/revive.go. The unit adds an hourly stop for steward starts: two or more steward sessions that ended without progress in the rolling hour, across any subjects, block the next start. The stop's message tells the person that 'metasystem machine revive' is the remedy, but that verb cannot clear it. The revive path closes the completed launch and clears only the abnormal-restart slots in the evidence file. The stop is counted from the seat records, which the revive leaves unchanged. So after the person acts, the next tick refuses again with the same remedy, for up to an hour, while the revive's own reply promises that 'the steward's next tick starts the next ready goal'. This also contradicts the design (D1, scenario S3): 'a new occurrence starts again'. With this stop in place, a new subject inside the hour does not start, and the per-occurrence cap of three can only be reached across more than an hour. In U3a no steward session can record progress yet (that comes in U3b), so any two steward sessions within an hour trigger this. Change: either drop the hourly count over steward no-progress records, so that a different subject is a different start as it is for goals (fix by subtraction; the per-occurrence counter already limits repeats), or name a remedy that clears what it counts."
